merge_policy: Unique additive IDs only after complete audit; reject unresolved imports/conflicts. No canonical item overwritten.

versioned_statement_imports.statement: Fixed capability changes imply full experiential-type changes under C1, without scalar monotonicity; usable information already treated.
Actual organization, finite views, task capability and named feelings/reports are different targets.

common_scope: Finite specified causal models only. Same task distribution, time, allowed future inputs and physical meaning of each clamp. H is not consciousness; R is not a phenomenal measure. No real-brain instance or experience-ranking premise supplied.

nodes.statement: Fix task distribution, boundary, time, installed mechanism and transported intervention family; define intact and post-intervention J.
nodes.scope: The same evaluative quantities apply in each compared instance.
excluded_inferences: unchanged task when external cues are added

nodes.statement: H=Q=c; select H, Q, or H OR Q; answer sum or product on x,y in {0,1,2,3}, uniform c; context report R=H.
nodes.scope: 32 equal-probability tasks; value clamp before selection, no later cue source access.

nodes.statement: All intact task answers match, but H-clamping produces accuracy 9/16, 1, 1 in shared, bypass, redundant systems.
nodes.scope: Specific physically matched intervention and fixed mechanisms.
excluded_inferences: all biological systems use shared route

nodes.statement: N distinct complete task-response profiles must be produced after only M distinguishable context-dependent code states remain.
nodes.scope: Fixed future mechanism; no further context-bearing input; whole-profile correctness distinct from single-query accuracy.
excluded_inferences: ignoring surviving environmental or compiled context

nodes.statement: Exact profile correctness requires M>=N; uniform complete-profile identification succeeds at most min(1,M/N).
nodes.proof: EI-T2 pigeonhole and sum of maximum encoder probabilities

nodes.statement: After both context carriers are erased, no decoder of x,y alone beats 9/16 expected arithmetic accuracy.
nodes.scope: Uniform 32 tasks, same mechanism/input contract, any x,y-only decoder.
nodes.proof: EI-T3: fourteen distinct-answer pairs contribute 1/2 and two equal-answer pairs contribute 1.
excluded_inferences: claiming the whole-profile 1/2 bound for each query

nodes.statement: Minimal sufficient context-route sets are {H}, {Q}, or either singleton, according to architecture.
nodes.scope: Zero-clamp, no-adaptation regime and arithmetic target only.
nodes.proof: Enumerate four retained subsets per architecture in check_core.py.
excluded_inferences: monotone effects of arbitrary brain lesions

nodes.statement: Selected model relations are constitutive relations of one independently admitted actual complete token under a common P/I/K.
nodes.scope: Actual bearer, interval, signature, boundary and realization are jointly required.
nodes.proof: Not supplied for a human or deployed AI.
excluded_inferences: abstract simulation implies complete actual realization

nodes.statement: C1 and the actual-instance premise give experiential structural counterparts of actual task-executing organizational relations.
nodes.scope: No independent experience-off switch at fixed complete organization; no particular familiar feeling inferred.

nodes.statement: Independently determine the named experiential counterpart of a task distinction or route in an admitted bearer.
nodes.scope: A report or a task function cannot define and validate the target circularly.
excluded_inferences: promoting an unresolved interpretation to theorem

rules.binding: Same x,y,c,source-copy interval and clamp semantics
One common profile domain, future decoder and cut
Both carriers erased; all possible x,y-only decoders
Same admitted actual P/I/K, not the abstract circuit alone
rules.proof: Tokenwise structural identity; not a named-target inference
